content.outcome: checkout-api compiles, tests, and runs against Acme Payments SDK v4 with identical externally observable behavior.

requirements.title: SDK upgraded to v4
requirements.statement: The manifest and lockfile pin acme-payments-sdk to the 4.x line and no 3.x artifact remains in the dependency graph.

requirements.title: No compatibility shims
requirements.statement: No deprecated v3 imports or compatibility shims remain in services/checkout-api.

requirements.title: Behavior preserved
requirements.statement: Public API, persisted schema, and authorization behavior are unchanged.

requirements.title: Release readiness
requirements.statement: The release record includes rollback conditions and an accountable owner.

acceptanceExpectations.statement: All existing contract and integration tests pass against the exact candidate.
Dependency scan shows no 3.x acme-payments-sdk artifact and no new dependencies.
Static analysis finds no import from acme_payments.v3 or *.compat.
Diff touches no files under api/public, schema/, or auth/.
The Release carries rollback conditions and an owner.

verificationExpectations.statement: Test evidence must be produced by an independent verifier Attempt.
Dependency and static-analysis evidence must be independent.
Scope evidence is derived by the control plane from the frozen diff.

constraints: No new runtime dependencies beyond the SDK upgrade

clarifications.question: Does v4's async client replace the sync client?
clarifications.answer: No. Keep the sync client; async migration is out of scope.

contributions.proposal: Add idempotency-key header semantics as a tracked risk.

finalizationRationale: Requirements identifiable, outcomes measurable, clarifications resolved, acceptance testable. Planning-ready; not approved.
